translations.web: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.
translations.bsb: His radiance was like the sunlight; rays flashed from His hand, where His power is hidden.
translations.kjv: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.
translations.asv: And his brightness was as the light; He had rays coming forth from his hand; And there was the hiding of his power.
